mapper.select: SELECT q.question_id AS questionId, q.title, q.difficulty, u.nick_name AS creatorName, q.create_time AS createTime FROM tb_exam_question eq INNER JOIN tb_question q ON eq.question_id = q.question_id LEFT JOIN tb_sys_user u ON q.create_by = u.user_id WHERE eq.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY eq.question_order ASC, eq.create_time ASC
